Eh. I really think this would have been better without the interview. Ending after the blood analysis leaves just enough room for extrapolation while still being intriguing — this rubs the reader's face in the narrative while screaming "ARE YOU HEARTWARMED YET!?".

I wanted to have a shorter SCP to try to keep in line with the Series 1 style. My original draft also had several overt references to the super poor treatment of D-class, that was common in early Series 1 works, but I removed them because they bogged the piece down and made the Foundation and Doctor come across as far more cruel than I wanted.

Thank you for reading my thing though.

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
Original article: SCP-577 "Bullet cat", by Dr. Kondraki

I chose to rename the article to "All Alone in the Moonlight". This is a line taken from the son "Memory", which is part of Andrew Lloyd Webber's musical Cats. I felt this title was appropriate, as the song is specifically about reminiscing about the happier past and coming to grips about where you are now, and how your life has lead to this point, and where it will go. That, when combined with the fact that it's from a play about cats made me think it worked perfectly for how I wrote the piece.

Thanks to Unclenicolini, aismallard, zyn, DrMagnus, and probably at least two other people I'm forgetting.
